## Community, in the age of robots

- We have no outside contributors, so the other party on an issue is
  usually one of my robots, and answering a robot is dispiriting
- It is not clear which repositories want robot-filed issues at all, and
  nobody has written the rule down
- `EpiAwareAgents` is one possible answer, a community bot any maintainer
  could point at their own repository
- It does not work. It is a design document, and its README says
  "Status: design phase. Nothing here runs yet"

::: {.attribution}
[EpiAwareAgents](https://github.com/EpiAware/EpiAwareAgents) README and
